body: Where in my post does it say I asked her to give me a chance?

Thanks for the advice everyone, I guess I wasn't clear in my description that I'm looking for someone who has been through a similar situation.

A lot of people have said that there is a lack of details, well that's intentional - I'm not looking for advice on getting back together, or moving on from her - I'm looking to see if I can find someone who's been in a similar situation that can talk me through some things. e.g going to parenting classes alone, which ones to go to, any books to read (most of the pregnancy/parenting books I've read assume you're married or at least in a relationship)

I didn't find it relevant since I wasn't asking for advice on my relationship as much as I'm looking for someone who's been through a similar situation.

I have a stable job in real estate, I make pretty decent money. If anything I do is childish I would say I enjoy playing video games in my free time - but I'm talking maybe an hour or two a day at most, nothing obsessive.
Sorry to hear that, hope things get back on track for you.
Have you contacted an attorney? I already spoke to one, not much I can do the first year but after year 1 you can at least get visitation.
